capabilities: Draw sticky notes, text, shapes, flowcharts, frames and freehand pen or highlighter strokes on Canvas boards
Connect cards with labelled straight, elbowed or curved arrows that follow them
Discuss through comment threads with replies, resolution, item locks and a review mode
Import existing boards from Miro, Excalidraw, Markmind, Enhancing Mindmap or Advanced Canvas
Export boards to PDF, PowerPoint and SVG with manual or frame-based page layout
disambiguation: Not a Miro integration or sync; it adds Miro-style tools to local .canvas files and only imports old Miro boards via a separate converter.
extras: Not yet published in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually. Line-to-line connections are experimental and off by default. Some styles are approximated when importing boards, and imported Miro tables lose cell text.
intentEvidence: Plan with sticky notes, sketch diagrams, draw and leave comments — all on Obsidian's own Canvas.
problem: Obsidian's Canvas lacks whiteboard tools such as sticky notes, pen drawing, comments, layered boards and rich document export.

relations.evidence: A visual workspace for your Obsidian notes, with Miro-style tools.
